item.text: The graph confirms that 20 named documents in the direct pack questions are withdrawn and have no pack link. Those queries will correctly return no rows. I’m now generating and checking all 138 queries for syntax and column order.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json, re, subprocess, collections, concurrent.futures
packet = json.load(open('packet.json'))
items = packet['items']
assert len(items) == 138
assert len({x['id'] for x in items}) == 138

patterns = {
 'pack': r'In which TSG RAN CR pack was change request (R5-\\d+) \\(CR (\\d+) to TS ([\\d.-]+)\\) submitted\\? Give the CR pack document number and the TSG RAN meeting\\.',
 'disposition': r'Change request (R5-\\d+) \\(CR (\\d+) to TS ([\\d.-]+)\\) was handled by RAN5\\. What source-verified disposition did RAN5 record for the whole document and at which RAN5 meeting, and in which TSG RAN CR pack was it then submitted\\? Give the disposition, the RAN5 meeting, the CR pack document number and the TSG RAN meeting\\.',
 'trace': r'Trace change request (R5-\\d+) \\(CR (\\d+) to TS ([\\d.-]+)\\) from the RAN5 decision to the clauses it modifies\\. Give the source-verified disposition RAN5 recorded for the whole document, the RAN5 meeting, the TSG RAN CR pack document number, the TSG RAN meeting, and each clause of TS ([\\d.-]+) that the CR modifies\\.',
 'clause': r'Which (Rel-\\d+) change requests that modify clause (\\S+) of TS ([\\d.-]+) have a source-verified RAN5 disposition for the whole document and were submitted in a TSG RAN CR pack\\? Give each document, its disposition, the RAN5 meeting, and the CR pack document number\\.',
 'revision': r'RAN5 recorded document (R5-\\d+) as revised\\. Follow its revisions to every later version that has a source-verified RAN5 disposition for the whole document and was submitted in a TSG RAN CR pack\\. Give each such document, that disposition, and the CR pack document number\\.',
 'pack_contents': r'TSG RAN CR pack (RP-\\d+) carries change requests from RAN5\\. For each change request in the pack that has a source-verified RAN5 disposition for the whole document, give the document, the disposition, and the RAN5 meeting\\.'
}
expected_fields = {
 'pack': ['cr_pack','tsg_meeting'],
 'disposition': ['disposition','wg_meeting','cr_pack','tsg_meeting'],
 'trace': ['disposition','wg_meeting','cr_pack','tsg_meeting','clause'],
 'clause': ['document','disposition','wg_meeting','cr_pack'],
 'revision': ['final_document','disposition','cr_pack'],
 'pack_contents': ['document','disposition','wg_meeting']
}
decision = \"\"\"MATCH (r:Resolution {resolutionScope: 'document_disposition'})-[:HAS_DISPOSITION]->(d:DecisionDisposition {evidenceStatus: 'source_verified'})-[:DISPOSITION_TARGET]->(c)
MATCH (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting {workingGroup: 'RAN5'})\"\"\"
projections = {
 'cr_pack': 'p.crPackId',
 'tsg_meeting': 'p.tsgMeeting',
 'document': 'c.tdocNumber',
 'final_document': 'c.tdocNumber',
 'disposition': 'd.dispositionCode',
 'wg_meeting': 'm.meetingNumber',
 'clause': 's.sectionNumber'
}
records = []
shape_counts = collections.Counter()
for item in items:
    matched = [(shape,re.fullmatch(pattern,item['question'])) for shape,pattern in patterns.items()]
    matched = [(shape,match) for shape,match in matched if match]
    assert len(matched) == 1, item['id']
    shape, match = matched[0]
    assert item['fields'] == expected_fields[shape], item['id']
    args = match.groups()
    if shape == 'pack':
        query = f\"MATCH (c:CR {{tdocNumber: '{args[0]}'}})-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(p:CRPack)\"
    elif shape == 'disposition':
        query = f\"MATCH (c:CR {{tdocNumber: '{args[0]}'}})-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(p:CRPack)\\n\" + decision
    elif shape == 'trace':
        assert args[2] == args[3]
        query = f\"\"\"MATCH (c:CR {{tdocNumber: '{args[0]}'}})-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(p:CRPack)
MATCH (c)-[:MODIFIES_SECTION]->(s:Section {{specNumber: '{args[2]}'}})
\"\"\" + decision
    elif shape == 'clause':
        query = f\"\"\"MATCH (c:CR)-[:MODIFIES_SECTION]->(s:Section {{specNumber: '{args[2]}', sectionNumber: '{args[1]}'}})
MATCH (c)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(:Release {{releaseName: '{args[0]}'}})
MATCH (c)-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(p:CRPack)
\"\"\" + decision
    elif shape == 'revision':
        query = f\"\"\"MATCH (seed:Tdoc {{tdocNumber: '{args[0]}'}})-[:REVISED_TO*1..]->(c:Tdoc)
MATCH (c)-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(p:CRPack)
\"\"\" + decision
    else:
        query = f\"MATCH (c:CR)-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(p:CRPack {{crPackId: '{args[0]}'}})\\n\" + decision
    query += '\\nRETURN DISTINCT ' + ', '.join(projections[field] + ' AS ' + field for field in item['fields'])
    aliases = re.findall(r'\\bAS\\s+([a-z_]+)',query)
    assert aliases == item['fields']
    assert query.count('RETURN DISTINCT') == 1
    assert not re.search(r'\\b(?:CREATE|MERGE|DELETE|DETACH|SET|REMOVE|CALL|LOAD|FOREACH|UNION|OPTIONAL|UNWIND|ORDER|LIMIT|SKIP)\\b',query)
    record = {'id':item['id'],'cypher':query}
    assert json.loads(json.dumps(record)) == record
    records.append(record)
    shape_counts[shape] += 1

def test_record(pair):
    item,record = pair
    proc = subprocess.run(['python3','query_graph.py',record['cypher']],capture_output=True,text=True)
    if proc.returncode:
        return {'id':item['id'],'error':proc.stderr or proc.stdout}
    try:
        result = json.loads(proc.stdout)
    except Exception:
        return {'id':item['id'],'error':proc.stdout}
    if result.get('columns') "'!= item['"'fields']:
        return {'id':item['id'],'error':result}
    return {'id':item['id'],'rowCount':result.get('rowCount'),'truncated':result.get('truncated',False)}

with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=6) as pool:
    checks = list(pool.map(test_record,zip(items,records)))
errors = [check for check in checks if 'error' in check]
if errors:
    print(json.dumps({'errors':errors},ensure_ascii=False))
    raise SystemExit(1)
normal_shapes = {re.sub(r\"'["'^'"']*'\",\"'?'\",record['cypher']) for record in records}
assert len(normal_shapes) == 6
assert len(records) == 138
print(json.dumps({'verified_queries':len(records),'distinct_shapes':len(normal_shapes),'shape_counts':shape_counts,'empty_results':[check['id'] for check in checks if check['rowCount']==0],'truncated':[check['id'] for check in checks if check['truncated']]},ensure_ascii=False))
for shape in patterns:
    sample = next(record for item,record in zip(items,records) if re.fullmatch(patterns[shape],item['question']))
    print(json.dumps({'shape':shape,**sample},ensure_ascii=False))

PY"
